# `plugin/`

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED by cargo xtask gen from docs/contributing/repo-layout.md's area tables; do not edit -->

This area's contract, from [Repo layout](../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#area-contracts).

- **Owns:** the shipped plugin.
- **May depend on:** built outputs and hand-written skills, agents, resolver.
- **Must not:** `bin/`; symlinks; hand-written copies of generated files; contributor rules in its user-facing `README.md`.
- **How to test it:** `claude plugin validate --strict`; `tests/plugin/`; `tests/installer/`.

Read first, from [Repo layout](../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#read-first-per-area):

- **Sections:** [Packaging and release](../docs/contributing/architecture.md#packaging-and-release); [Plugin layout](../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#plugin-layout).
- **Records:** [DR-28](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-28-engine-bootstrap-without-a-sessionstart-hook), [DR-58](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-58-one-data-root-a-self-locating-resolver-an-embedded-canvas-and-visible-background-work), [DR-69](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-69-releases-from-main-a-portable-detach-and-a-resolver-contract), [DR-78](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-78-releases-users-install-detached-work-in-its-own-session-a-canvas-port-that-never-moves-and-machine-wide-files-across-versions), [DR-79](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-79-gates-that-fire-only-where-they-mean-something).
- **Scenarios:** S14.

## Notes

- A skill's name can't equal a command the mod registers (`/room`): the host refuses the command and skips the mod's start. The plugin layout check enforces it ([DR-84](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-84-the-umbrella-skill-is-planroom-so-the-mod-can-own-room)).
- Loaded as a dev mod, this folder gets `tsconfig.json` and `.claude-plugin/types/` from the host. Both are gitignored and kept out of the version stamp.
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`'s version is stamped by `cargo xtask gen` from this folder's tracked files, so any change here changes it ([DR-83](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-83-what-the-walking-skeletons-gates-remote-slice-and-platform-checks-settled)).
- Loaded live as a mod, this folder is the plugin root the guard write-protects: an agent can't Write, Edit or name it in a Bash write until the mod is unloaded, or a person makes the change ([DR-87](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-87-what-the-walking-skeletons-review-settled-in-round-3)).
